title: TTPPrototypeCommissioningRun
description: One prototype commissioning run for the TTP-PROTOTYPE-001 PROTOTYPE track: an economical, off-the-shelf physical chain used to close a measurement loop and gather engineering evidence. This is NOT the DO-103 measured-force campaign. A prototype run may use manual or commanded excitation and a microphone-only response path, and it may carry NO measured force channel. It shares the provenance vocabulary of ttp_hardware_campaign_v1 (evidence_origin, witnessed, SHA-256 artifact identity) but does not share its physical claim: nothing here asserts measured force, reference-grade accuracy, or qualified/production hardware. A run that has not executed says so, and a run that was halted at a gate is recorded rather than deleted.

stage.description: R0 real-material manual-tap acquisition; R1 known added-mass challenge; R2 commanded closed excitation loop. The stage bounds what the run may claim: R0 is manual and cannot claim controlled excitation; R1 requires an actual measured added mass; R2 requires emission provenance for a commanded signal.

status.description: Reuses the ttp_hardware_campaign_v1 outcome vocabulary. A NOT_EXECUTED run is a prepared record with nothing captured; a HALTED_AT_GATE or BLOCKED_BY_GATE run is a real, retained result and names why it stopped.

evidence_origin.description: Reused verbatim from the campaign vocabulary. Only HARDWARE is hardware evidence. Required in practice on an EXECUTED run; null while NOT_EXECUTED.

witnessed.description: Whether the run met the stricter witnessed standard. Only HARDWARE-origin evidence may carry it; a fixture or synthetic run may not.

halt_reason.description: Why a HALTED_AT_GATE or BLOCKED_BY_GATE run stopped. A halted run is recorded, not deleted.

excitation.description: How the specimen was excited. MANUAL is a hand tap and carries no controlled-excitation chain. COMMANDED is a TTP-emitted waveform driven through an output device, amplifier, and exciter, and must carry emission provenance.

commanded_amplitude.description: The commanded electrical amplitude of a COMMANDED excitation. This is a commanded electrical quantity, never an applied mechanical force.

emission_provenance.description: Provenance of a commanded emitted signal. Present for a COMMANDED excitation; it records what TTP emitted, not what force reached the specimen.

response.description: The response sensing path. The prototype senses non-contact by microphone, so no sensor mass is added to the specimen.

force_boundary.description: The force-measurement boundary. The prototype does not measure force by default. A run may claim measured force only when it carries a force_chain: a commanded electrical signal is never, by itself, an applied mechanical force.

force_chain.description: The force-measurement chain that would substantiate a measured-force claim. Its calibration vocabulary is reused from the campaign channel model.

added_mass.description: A known mass deliberately added for an R1 challenge. The measured mass is what any later delta is computed from; the nominal value is recorded beside it and never substituted for it.

external_artifact.description: One retained raw measurement held outside this repository. Identity is the SHA-256 digest; the locator is where a copy may currently be found, and local_path_hint is explicitly ephemeral. Same conventions as ttp_hardware_campaign_v1.

quality_result.description: The deterministic quality-gate outcome for the run, carried verbatim from the existing gate. Advisory or narrative text may never change this result.

environment.description: Recorded conditions. null means unknown and stays unknown; no normalization is applied.
